en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a small railway station named Billingsfors. The main wooden station building has a steep tiled roof, dormer with the sign "BILLINGSFORS", flower boxes under the windows, and people sitting on a bench on the platform. Railway tracks run across the foreground. To the right is a smaller trackside building and some houses among tall trees. The corners of the image have white frame marks, and printed caption text appears at the bottom.
